Settings.EnabledHint: Automatically applies dice modifiers from weapon qualities (e.g. Accurate 1 → +1 Boost die) to every attack roll.
Settings.CustomQualitiesHint: Advanced: a JSON object mapping quality names to dice modifications. Keys are quality names exactly as written on the item. Each entry has 'glyphs' (array) and 'rated' (bool). Glyphs: B=Boost, S=Setback, A=Ability, P=Proficiency, D=Difficulty, C=Challenge, ^=Upgrade Ability die, *=Downgrade Ability die, _=Upgrade Difficulty die, ~=Downgrade Difficulty die. Example: {"Guided":{"glyphs":["^"],"rated":false},"Inaccurate":{"glyphs":["S"],"rated":true}}

UI.QualityModsHint: These dice will be added automatically when you click Roll.
UI.NoMods: No quality dice modifiers for this weapon.
